title: A planted headless worker session's rows reach its item's cost, an orchestrator session's stay out
goal: A test plants a spool with a headless worker session (a branch row of work/<id>, then usage rows) and an orchestrator session of the same item (claim, done rows only on prompts outside the worker): backlog.py cost ID and cost --rework SP count the worker's runs and tokens on the item and leave the orchestrator's prompts outside the item's window, and usage.md says how a worker in an orchestrator-made worktree is attributed.
